title: QBR Executive Decision Brief + 30-Day Activation Rundown
body:
Purpose and outcome (1 sentence): Run an efficient executive-facing QBR that surfaces the single critical renewal decision, captures executive commitments, and produces a signed 30-day activation plan with owners, success criteria, and escalation paths.

Quick summary for execs (one pager to open meeting):
- Customer: Acme Retail (Acct 123) — contract up for renewal 2026-01-15
- Renewal ask: 12-month commitment for Dedicated capacity + Premium SLAs
- Key KPI wins: 27% latency reduction on peak routes, embedding accuracy stable @0.91 NDCG, cost/unit down 18% after caching changes
- Primary blocker: integration of on-prem KMS for Private deployment (security signoff pending)
- Decision requested (explicit): Approve renewal under the proposed SKUs and 30-day activation plan with go/no-go checklist.

Pre-read materials (attach and confirm distribution 48h before):
- One-page health snapshot (metrics + trendlines) — required
- Migration/ops risk memo (security & KMS status) — required
- Proposed commercial term summary (pricing + discounts) — required
- 30-day technical activation draft (owners & milestones) — draft for discussion
- Open tickets list (SLA breaches + P1s in last 90d) — optional but helpful

Attendees & roles (keep tight, execs only + 3 CS leads):
- Customer exec sponsor (decision maker) — required
- CS lead (facilitator) — run the meeting, own decision ledger (Maya Rodriguez)
- Solutions engineer — technical clarifier and owner of implementation milestones (Ethan Park)
- Security/compliance SME — present for KMS okays (Jordan Kim)
- Finance/Procure contact (customer) — when contract terms discussed (Priya Nair optional)

Timeboxed agenda (45 minutes total)
- 0:00–0:05 — Opening (facilitator): meeting purpose, desired decision, confirm attendees and timeboxes
- 0:05–0:12 — Health snapshot (CS lead): top 3 metrics, 90d trends, one risk highlight
- 0:12–0:20 — Commercial summary (CS lead & finance): proposed term, known exceptions, discount levers
- 0:20–0:30 — Technical risk & remediation (solutions + security): KMS status, mitigation options, estimated dates
- 0:30–0:38 — Decision framing & options (facilitator): present 2–3 clear options and recommendation
- 0:38–0:43 — Exec decision + commitments (customer exec): capture explicit sign-off and ask for immediate owners
- 0:43–0:45 — Next steps & closing (facilitator): confirm post-QBR deliverables, follow-ups, and next review date

Facilitator script (compact, to be read or paraphrased)
- Opening: “Thanks everyone for joining. Our objective: secure an executable renewal decision today and a signed 30-day activation plan so we can start delivering value immediately. We’ll run 45 minutes and capture the decision in the ledger.”
- Framing the options: “We have three feasible paths: 1) Approve full term + private KMS migration plan, 2) Approve term with temporary hosted-only SLA while KMS completes, or 3) Pause renewal and enter a 30-day hold with defined success criteria. Recommendation is option 1 with guarded go/nogo on KMS staging.”
- Driving to a decision: “What I need from the exec today is explicit confirmation of option X, identification of the internal owner for procurement, and agreement to the 30-day activation milestones. If we can get that, CS will issue an activation ticket within 24 hours.”

Decision ledger template (fill live in doc and include in meeting notes)
- Decision ID: D-YYYY-001
- Decision statement: (one sentence)
- Options considered: (list)
- Recommendation: (CS recommended option + rationale)
- Decision: (chosen option + timestamp)
- Decision owner (customer): (name, email)
- Implementation owner (Redwood): (name)
- Target completion date: YYYY-MM-DD
- Acceptance criteria: (1–3 bullet success items)
- Contingency if not met: (escalation path)

30-Day activation rundown (compact template to be edited live)
- Action: Create private KMS staging environment
  - Owner: Solutions eng (Ethan Park)
  - Due: 7 days from decision
  - Success criteria: KMS keys accessible from Redwood Private; automated key rotation verified
- Action: Finalize procurement PO and sign contract
  - Owner: Customer finance (name) + Redwood AE
  - Due: 10 days from decision
  - Success criteria: Signed order form uploaded to shared drive
- Action: Run baseline performance smoke test on Dedicated pool
  - Owner: Platform eng (Redwood)
  - Due: 14 days from decision
  - Success criteria: <2% regression vs pre-cutover baseline on top-3 endpoints
- Action: Post-cutover monitoring dashboard + alert thresholds
  - Owner: CS operations
  - Due: 21 days
  - Success criteria: Dashboards live, two alert playbooks validated
- Action: Executive check-in and closeout
  - Owner: CS lead
  - Due: 30 days
  - Success criteria: Exec signoff on migration & SLA metrics met

Risk thermostat (how to present to execs)
- Low (green): Minor config work, no policy change — low chance of delay
- Medium (amber): Dependent on third-party security/compliance review — modest risk to timeline
- High (red): Requires on-site audit or air-gapped approval — likely >30d delay
(Annotate the single highest risk and recommended mitigation in the meeting)

Pre-QBR checklist for CS owner (48–24h tasks)
- Confirm attendee list and timezones, send calendar invite with pre-reads attached
- Prepare one-pager health snapshot and a 2-slide technical risk summary
- Run internal dry-run with Solutions & Security (15 min) to prep talking points
- Prepare Decision ledger as a ready-to-fill doc and Slack-ready follow-up snippets

Post-QBR cadence and templates
- Within 24h: Send decision note + populated decision ledger + 30-day activation plan to attendees (CS lead)
- Weekly (every 7d): 15-minute activation standup between CS, Solutions, and customer owners (notes in shared doc)
- 30-day: Executive closeout meeting (15 min) and updated health snapshot

Post-QBR email template (short)
Subject: Outcome — QBR & 30-day activation (Acct 123)
Body: Hi <ExecName>, thanks for your time today. Per the decision (D-2025-XXX), we agreed to <chosen option>. Attached: decision ledger, 30-day activation plan, and owners. CS will kick off action items within 24h. Our first activation standup is scheduled for <date>.

Notes to self / facilitator (scratchpad)
- Keep commercial talk <=8 minutes; get to technical blocker quickly
- If exec pushes for more time, offer a green/amber/red gating criteria instead of open-ended postponement
- Capture every ask as an action with owner or explicitly mark it as future backlog

One-line success definition (for the meeting): Secure a binary executive decision and a measurable 30-day plan with named owners so the team can start execution within 24 hours.

Attachments recommended: health_snapshot.pdf, commercial_summary.pdf, kms_risk_memo.pdf, activation_plan_draft.xlsx

Revision history:
